topic: What if everyone disappeared except you?

script.text: By the end of the first day, you have worked out three rules.

One. It happened at 3:07 in the morning. Every phone you pick up has its last message from before 3:07. Nothing after. The TV shows the same thing on every channel: an empty news desk, with the studio lights still on.
Two. Only people are gone. Dogs, cats, pigeons, the goldfish in the pet shop. All still here.
Three. Everything people were holding stayed exactly where it was. A pair of slippers in the middle of the hallway. A toothbrush on the bathroom floor.
You call everyone you know. Mum. Your best friend Mo. Grandma. Every call just rings and rings, and you can picture each phone, buzzing on an empty table.
And then there's one more thing. On your little sister Ellie's bed, her walkie-talkie is switched on, hissing quietly. Ellie never leaves it on. You switch it off. Remember that walkie-talkie.
